# WinRAR MCP (v0.3.1)

A state-of-the-art Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for industrial WinRAR archive management on Windows.

## Technical Core
- **Framework**: FastMCP 3.1 (stdio transport) / Starlette (HTTP transport)
- **Engine**: Python 3.12+ / WinRAR CLI (`Rar.exe`, `UnRAR.exe`)
- **Dashboard**: React 18 / Vite / HSL-tailored Dark Mode
- **Test Suite**: Pytest with modular industrial fixtures and handler verification

## Tools (17 individual)
- **Archive creation**: create_archive, create_sfx_archive, archive_repo
- **Archive extraction**: extract_archive
- **Archive management**: add_to_archive, delete_from_archive, archive_info, list_archive, test_archive
- **Advanced analysis**: analyze_compression_efficiency, batch_archive_operations, compare_archives, smart_archive_backup, archive_health_monitor, secure_file_operations
- **System**: help, status

## Operational Standards
- **Wait Policy**: Async job stores for long-running archive tasks; polling via `/api/v1/jobs`
- **Error Handling**: Structured `ArchiveError` with detailed stderr capture
- **Testing**: `just test` / `just test-cov` for developer validation

## Repository Layout
- `src/winrarmcp/`: Core service logic and MCP server definition
- `webapp/`: High-performance React dashboard and Starlette API bridge
- `tests/`: Modular test suite with shared fixtures
- `justfile`: Industrial operations dashboard
